interface.signature: def canConvertString(s: str, t: str, k: int) -> bool:

preconditions.description: The lengths of input strings s and t must be equal.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must contain only lowercase English letters.
The number of moves k must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all((ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i])) % 26 == 0 for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: For each character in s and t, the difference between their ASCII values modulo 26 must be zero (i.e., t can be obtained by shifting characters of s cyclically).

postconditions.expression: sum(min((ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i])) % 26, 26 - ((ord(t[i]) - ord(s[i])) % 26)) for i in range(len(s))) <= k
postconditions.description: The sum of the minimal shifts required for each character in s to match t (considering both forward and backward shifts) must be less than or equal to k.
